drawer.retention_hint: Archive to object storage after this period.
drawer.shards_hint: Parallel datasource write lanes; keep this at least as high as write nodes.
drawer.indexed_fields_hint: Comma-separated fields for fast equality and prefix searches.
drawer.encrypted_fields_hint: Comma-separated fields encrypted at rest; read back with decrypt(field). Cannot be toggled later.
drawer.queryable_hint: When off, this stream still ingests and retains data but is hidden from query selectors and rejected by search — use it for a source stream that only feeds a routing pipeline. You can change this later in settings.

toast.create_pending: Stream {{name}} is registered on first datasource write; no /streams create endpoint yet.

detail.subtitle: Stream details
detail.not_found_description: The stream may not have been registered by a datasource yet.

explore.subtitle: Runtime health, query efficiency, storage, and retention
explore.system_stream_immutable: System streams only allow field indexing, extraction, and masking configuration. Identity, encryption, retention, and deletion are system-managed.

metadata.switch_blocked: Save or discard the current type's changes before switching types.

overview.stats_unavailable: Runtime stats are unavailable. Configuration remains editable; refresh to probe storage metadata again.
overview.no_data_description: Send datasource traffic to “{{stream}}”, or submit a test event to verify the ingest path.
overview.no_chart_data: No chartable data in this time range

schema.readonly_hint: Read-only by default. Use the edit action to change indexing, extraction, and masking.
schema.fts_title: Full-text search is configured per field
schema.fts_description: Enable full-text indexing on fields such as message or body to speed up MATCH queries. Existing data is not reindexed automatically.
schema.condition_hint: Build this field index only when the expression matches; leave empty to always enable it.
schema.index_type_hint: Exact matching suits IDs; full text suits natural language.
schema.extraction_hint: Patterns run in order during ingest; enter one regular expression per line.
schema.encrypted_hint: This field is encrypted before storage. It cannot be toggled here without making existing data unreadable.
schema.drawer_subtitle: Configure query indexing, ingest-time extraction, and result masking without changing the field type.
schema.no_schema: This stream has no schema yet. Fields appear after the first datasource write.

masking.title: Result field masking
masking.description: The backend masks final query results, exports, and API responses. Filtering, sorting, and aggregation still use raw values.
masking.no_global_rule_hint: The field is currently unmasked while inheriting. A future matching global rule will apply automatically.
masking.explicit_none_hint: This field explicitly bypasses global masking for this stream. Select inherit to restore global behavior.
masking.metrics_disabled: Metrics streams do not participate in field masking. Metric values and labels remain unchanged; indexing and extraction stay configurable.

retention.days_default_hint: Leave blank to use the global retention of {{days}} days.
retention.default_explanation: Data that does not match an exception rule follows the default retention. Reducing it may delete expired data in the next cleanup run.
retention.exception_rules_hint: Match in priority order to retain high-value and low-value data for different periods.
retention.no_rules: No exception rules. All data follows the default retention.
retention.keep_condition_hint: Matching records are retained; empty means all data not matching an exception follows the default period.

usage.write_source_hint: Ingest endpoint receiving this stream name
usage.pipelines_hint: Use this stream as a source or target
usage.partial_unavailable: Some dependency services are unavailable; this result may be incomplete.

runtime.basic_hint: Explain the business data and purpose of this stream.
runtime.query_capabilities_hint: Control query access and range. Disabling query access does not stop ingest.
runtime.storage_behavior_hint: Affects storage and partitioning for newly ingested data.
runtime.queryable_hint: When off, this stream keeps ingesting and retaining data but is hidden from query selectors and rejected by search. Use it for a source stream that only feeds a routing pipeline.

changes.review: The new configuration takes effect immediately after saving.
changes.index_risk: Index and extraction changes affect only new data; existing data is not reindexed automatically.
changes.retention_risk: Retention will be reduced to {{days}} days and expired data may be deleted.
changes.query_risk: After query access is disabled, this stream still ingests data but queries and searches are rejected.

explore.delete_confirm_description: “{{stream}}” and its configuration will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
